newsitem.title: CANADA: MacMillan, natives for Clayoquot venture.
newsitem.headline: MacMillan, natives for Clayoquot venture.

text.p: Canadian forest company MacMillan Bloedel Ltd said on Wednesday that it agreed to form a joint venture with native Indians in the Clayoquot Sound area of British Columbia.
The so far unnamed company will take over MacMillan's timber tenure in the northern part of Clayoquot Sound and be 51 percent-owned by the five Nuu-Chah-Nulth First Nations.

The ancient rain forests of Clayoquot Sound of Vancouver Island have been a focal point for environmental protests. MacMillan has been targeted by environmental activists who oppose logging in the area.
